name: @psyb0t/mailbox
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted docker-mailbox IMAP/SMTP control plane over MCP — read, search, send, mark-seen, and delete mail across multiple inboxes.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running docker-mailbox instance's MCP endpoint (/mcp), exposing its tools: mailboxes (discovery), inbox (unified cross-account read), list_folders, list_messages, search, get_message, delete_message, mark_seen, and send. docker-mailbox is a multi-mailbox IMAP/SMTP control plane exposed as a REST API + MCP server on a single port. It is self-hosted — you run the server yourself and point this bridge at it. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-mailbox.

MAILBOX_URL.description: Base URL of your running mailboxd server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the bridge appends /mcp).

MAILBOX_TOKEN.description: Bearer token, only if the mailboxd server was started with auth.tokens configured.

url.description: Base URL of your running mailboxd server, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (the bridge appends /mcp).

token.description: Bearer token, only if the mailboxd server was started with auth.tokens configured.
